home.valueCareText: Simple recipes, familiar flavours and care in every detail.
home.valueDeliveryText: Order online and enjoy homemade food without leaving home.
home.aboutTitle: A small kitchen with a big heart
home.aboutText: Osito a la carta began with a wish to share the dishes that bring everyone around the table. We’re a small family team in Valencia, cooking so every order feels personal, delicious and made for you.
home.aboutPointOne: A friendly experience from choosing your meal to receiving it.
home.aboutPointTwo: A menu inspired by home cooking and timeless flavours.
home.howTitle: Your next favourite meal in three steps
home.stepOneText: Browse the menu and find something you’re craving.
home.stepTwoText: Add your favourites to the cart and confirm your order.
home.stepThreeText: We’ll get cooking so you can enjoy a meal at home.
home.visitTitle: A taste of home in Valencia
home.visitText: Browse the menu and place your order online. These location and opening details are provisional.
